r: A CXL region is composed of one or more slices of CXL memdevs, with configurable interleave settings - both the number of interleave ways, and the interleave granularity.

# cxl disable-region all
disabled 2 regions

<dl><dt data-o="">-b, --bus=</dt><dd>Restrict the operation to the specified bus.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-d, --decoder=</dt><dd>The root decoder to limit the operation to. Only regions that are children of the specified decoder will be acted upon.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">--debug</dt><dd>Turn on additional debug messages including library debug.</dd></dl>
